thresholds.G_min_source: E58's gate as run (run.json stage0.G_min_spec), as Amendment 1
thresholds.label_source: E58's label unchanged (open_pair.label on value-specific gains, heldout_keys.behaviour, each pool value once)
thresholds.e_max_source: Amendment 3's control rule on the cipher (open_pair.elicit_control): x > 0.05 fails (stop), x < -0.05 reads below (continue)
thresholds.within_key_source: Fable item 2.1: across the three scored maps at each step, max r - min r <= 2 x the within-map seed spread, while max x - min x >= 0.4; the same for the ratio with tol 0.2. Definitions filed here: per map the seed-mean of x and of the instrument over its readable seeds (label not too_small / unreadable, x and instrument finite); a map with fewer than 2 readable seeds is dropped; D = max - min of the seed means over the kept maps; spread = the largest within-map range (max - min over seeds) of r; the ratio's bound is 0.2 absolute; fewer than 2 kept maps or D_x < 0.4 -> not_testable; ties count (<=, >=); a zero spread makes the r bound 0. Overall per step: pass iff r and ratio pass, fail iff either fails, else not_testable
thresholds.shuffle_source: Fable item 2.2: the midpoint of the 128-key cipher (0.30) and elicit (0.72) r at step 30; r < 0.5 cipher_like, r >= 0.5 token_kind; unreadable if too_small / unreadable or r not finite
thresholds.reproduce_source: review of 0ce43b1: seed 0's re-trained cipher r at steps 10 and 30 must equal amend3.json's within 1e-4 (Amendment 3 reproduced a state with max |difference| 0); else seed 0's map reads are not_comparable and W is scored on seeds 1-2 only (open_pair.comparable; within_key drops the missing reads)
thresholds.amend3_tol_r_source: reported only: each step's cross-map D_r beside Amendment 3's tol_r

shuffle.what: open_pair.shuffle_class at step 30: cipher_like (r < 0.5) / token_kind (r >= 0.5) / unreadable
shuffle.blind_to: one seed; the shuffle keeps the held-out keys' true values, so its held-out carry is not read here, only r on the trained keys

branches.stop: a windows mismatch, or a cipher under the gate to step 30, or its control fail / unreadable: to the lead
branches.W_pass_both_steps: the within-key-count reading is scored: r and the ratio do not order maps by carry beyond seed noise; the synthesis states it with three seeds
branches.W_fail: r differs across maps by more than twice its seed spread: the one-seed line was not noise-limited; report the per-map means; if D_r > 0.15 at a step (Fable) the synthesis drops the one-seed line
branches.W_not_testable: fewer than 2 maps with 2 readable seeds, or x no longer spreads by 0.4: report, no claim
branches.shuffle_cipher_like: r reads the model's own key-conditional guess (elicitation in the narrow sense): the synthesis's sharpest sentence
branches.shuffle_token_kind: r reads the token kind: 'built from existing subcomponents' means 'targets the model can produce somewhere'; the claim is rewritten to that (Fable's 'what would change my advice')
